name: DtlJumpPhase
meaning: DaffyTrainingLevel.initFlag (+0x22c): the phase of a hop in DaffyTrainingLevel::MoveTo (gait DTL_GAIT_JUMP from help point 3 on). PostLoadInit, SetMode 0, a finished move and each new help point set it back to 1

name: DTL_JUMP_TAKEOFF
meaning: JUMP3 until it finishes (no arc movement yet); a jump that starts closer than 50 lands at once

name: DTL_JUMP_RISE
meaning: JUMP4 on the arc until it passes its top (sine index > 0x400)

name: DTL_JUMP_FALL
meaning: JUMP5 on the arc until within 50 of the node or past the jump time; then the next node, or DTL_JUMP_LAND at the last one

name: DTL_JUMP_LAND
meaning: JUMP6 at the last node until it finishes (the switch default)
